response.text:
This is a duplicate_invoice finding, so voiding is permitted. The duplicate is INV_ID 801 (status O, the later entry, with the trailing space in INV_NO). The original 465 is paid (P), so it should be kept and 801 voided.

The correction should reverse journal 2458's effect on AP and expense. Journal 2458 debited 5100 for 12185.45 and credited 2000 for 12185.45. A reversing journal in open period 11 or 12 (I'll use period 12 as the current open period) debits 2000 and credits 5100 by the same amount, referencing 2458. Since the status change is V for 801, that's allowed for duplicate_invoice.

Journal 2458 sits in period 9, which is closed, so the reversal must go to an open period. Period 12 is open.

The correction reverses journal 2458 in open period 12 (since period 9 is closed): debit 2000 Accounts Payable Control and credit 5100 Office Supplies, both 12185.45. Invoice 801 is set to status V. Journal 2458 is not edited; the reversal references it via corrects_jrnl_no. Net effect: one liability and one expense entry remain, matching invoice 465.
